contexts.text: This does the man no harm.
The evil which enters the thought does not hurt the man at all... But when evil enters the will, then it hurts...
The flying hurtful thing () = the falsities of that evil. ( = the falsities of malevolence. AC 7442.)
See Honour.
This (illegitimate) conjunction does not hurt those who...

By evil uses... are meant all the noxious things in (the three kingdoms of nature)... To pile up the names of them without any indication of the injury which each kind produces, would not promote the use this work has in view. (Some of them enumerated.)
All things which do injury and kill men.
The reason noxious things are produced from Hell upon the Earth...
The things which... correspond to noxious animals...
Noxious flying things fill the atmosphere... and noxious worms the earth...
That such noxious little animals and insects... are hatched from eggs, is not supported by experience...
That the noxious things upon the Earth originate from man, and thus from Hell... DLW 347:end.
To want to hurt the two witnesses () = to want to destroy these two essentials of the New Church...
An evil and hurtful ulcer () = interior evils and falsities destructive of all the good and truth in the Church. By hurtful is signified what is destructive.
A Spirit... who (meditated about) how to injure me... There are many such in our Earth...
The Lord disposed... that they should do me no injury.
(Thus) nothing can hurt those who are in faith...
It does not injure him who believes this fallacy, and yet lives well.
If anyone wants to hurt them = their protection by the Lord lest they should be injured in any way.
If anyone wants to hurt them, so must he be killed = that according to the endeavour to inflict evil they will perish.
A great and hurtful ulcer = the evil works there, and the consequent falsifications of truth... Hurtful is predicated of what is falsified.
All who are in the love of self, according to the delight of that love, are in the delight of doing injury to others who do not make one with them... This appears manifestly after death...
